legal_template_notice: This document is a template pending legal review and applies to self-hosted evaluation deployments.
setup_legal_agree: By creating an account you agree to the Terms of Service and acknowledge the Privacy Policy.
privacy_intro: Finance Tracker stores your financial records so you can track your own spending. This policy explains what we store, why, who processes it, and the rights you have over it. We do not sell data or show ads.
privacy_what_body: Your email address and password hash; the accounts, categories, transactions, categorization rules, and monthly budgets you create, plus a record of which over-budget alert emails we sent you; bank statement rows you import; receipt images you upload and the line items extracted from them; usage metadata for AI receipt scanning (call counts and token usage, never receipt contents); and your subscription status if you pay for Pro.
privacy_why_body: Solely to provide the service to you: showing your own data back to you, importing statements, scanning receipts, enforcing plan quotas, and billing. We never use your financial data for advertising, profiling, or training AI models.
privacy_ai_body: When you scan a receipt, the image is sent to the configured AI provider to extract line items. Deployments can use a self-hosted model instead, in which case receipt images never leave the server. The raw AI response is kept for {days} days for debugging and then automatically deleted; the extracted items remain yours to edit or delete.
privacy_subprocessors_intro: Depending on deployment configuration, the following categories of third parties may process data on our behalf:
privacy_sub_hosting: Hosting provider — runs the application server and database.
privacy_sub_storage: Object storage provider — stores uploaded receipt images.
privacy_sub_stripe: Stripe — payment processing and subscription management. We never see your card number.
privacy_sub_email: Resend — sends transactional email (verification, password reset, account notices).
privacy_sub_ai: OpenRouter (or another configured AI provider) — receives receipt images for line-item extraction, unless the deployment uses a self-hosted model.
privacy_retention_body: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. Raw AI responses are deleted after {days} days. When you delete your account, all rows and receipt images are permanently removed after a {graceDays}-day grace period, and your Stripe customer record is deleted.
privacy_rights_body: You can export all of your data as a zip archive and permanently delete your account, both from the Settings page — no support ticket needed. You can edit or delete any individual record at any time. EU users additionally have GDPR rights to rectification, restriction, and complaint to a supervisory authority.
privacy_cookies_body: We use a single first-party session cookie to keep you signed in. There are no analytics, advertising, or third-party cookies, so no consent banner is required.
privacy_contact_body: For any privacy question or request, contact the operator of this deployment (see the address in the site's security.txt).
terms_intro: These terms govern your use of Finance Tracker. By creating an account you agree to them.
terms_service_body: Finance Tracker is a personal finance tracking tool: manual entry, bank statement import, categorization, and AI receipt scanning. It is a record-keeping aid, not financial, tax, or accounting advice.
terms_account_body: You are responsible for keeping your password secure and for everything done under your account. You must provide a working email address so we can reach you about security and account matters.
terms_billing_body: The free plan has usage limits. The Pro subscription is billed through Stripe and renews monthly until canceled; you can cancel any time from the billing portal and keep Pro until the end of the paid period. Quotas exist to prevent abuse and may change with notice.
terms_data_body: Your financial data belongs to you. You can export it or delete your account at any time from Settings. We process it only as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms_acceptable_body: Do not attempt to access other users' data, disrupt the service, or abuse the AI scanning quota. We may suspend accounts that do.
terms_liability_body: The service is provided as-is, without warranty. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the service in the preceding 12 months. Always verify imported and AI-extracted figures against your bank's records.
terms_termination_body: You can delete your account at any time. We may terminate accounts that violate these terms; where reasonable we will give you a chance to export your data first.
terms_changes_body: We may update these terms; material changes will be announced by email before they take effect.
security_intro: Financial data is sensitive, and this page explains how we protect it and how to report a vulnerability.
security_data_body: Your records live in a Postgres database and receipt images in object storage, both encrypted at rest by the hosting provider and reachable only over TLS. Passwords are stored as bcrypt hashes. Money is stored as integer minor units. Transaction contents and receipt data are never written to application logs or error reports.
security_measures_body: Login rate limiting and progressive lockout, session revocation ("log out everywhere"), CSRF protection, a strict Content-Security-Policy, upload size and type validation, and per-user AI usage quotas. Every data query is scoped to your user id on the server.
security_reporting_body: If you find a security issue, please report it responsibly using the contact listed in our security.txt file. We will acknowledge reports promptly and will not take action against good-faith research.
security_residency_body: Production deployments are recommended to be EU-hosted; the deployment operator's privacy policy states the actual hosting region. The self-hosted AI option keeps receipt images entirely on the operator's own infrastructure.
